build_task_with_define_task_decorator: use the define_task decorator to register a build_task function that creates a PHYRE task scene
create_dynamic_bars_with_C_add: create dynamic bar bodies in the PHYRE scene using C.add with scale and angle parameters
create_dynamic_balls_with_C_add: create dynamic ball bodies in the PHYRE scene using C.add and set their center position
set_task_goal_with_update_task: set the task goal by calling C.update_task with body1, body2, and a spatial relationship list
use_spatial_relationship_above: use C.SpatialRelationship.ABOVE to define a task where body1 must end up above body2
